description: Look up a domain's registration record — registrar, created/expiry dates, nameservers, EPP status codes, DNSSEC flag, and registrant org (where not privacy-redacted). Uses RDAP via IANA bootstrap to auto-select the correct per-TLD RDAP server, returning one normalized shape regardless of TLD. When the TLD has no RDAP coverage, throws rdap_no_coverage. If the domain is not registered, throws domain_not_found — use whois_check_availability to test availability without triggering an error.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to look up (e.g., "example.com", "github.com"). Must be a valid FQDN — labels separated by dots, each label up to 63 chars.

name: whois_lookup_domain

dnssec_signed.description: True when the domain has DNSSEC delegation signed.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_domain`: Input is not a valid FQDN. `rdap_no_coverage`: TLD has no RDAP server in the IANA bootstrap — cannot perform lookup. `domain_not_found`: RDAP server returned 404 — domain is not registered. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

handle.description: Registry handle / object identifier assigned by the registry.

rdap_coverage.description: True when a RDAP server was found for this TLD; false when RDAP coverage is absent.

rdap_last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last RDAP database update.

registrant_org.description: Registrant organization name. Omitted when privacy-redacted.

registrant_redacted.description: True when registrant contact data is privacy-redacted (common post-GDPR).

updated_date.description: ISO 8601 date of last registration record change.

title: Domain Registration Lookup
